page.overview:
Who is Captain, HMS Chester?

The Captain is a fictional unnamed commanding officer of the British Royal Navy flagship, HMS Chester. A minor character, he briefly appeared in the 1997 James Bond film, Tomorrow Never Dies, and was portrayed by actor Bruce Alexander.

This unnamed navy captain received a direct order from Admiral Roebuck to launch a cruise missile at a terrorist market on the Russian border. When Roebuck orders him to destroy the missile shortly afterwards, he has to tell his superior that this is impossible.
